messages:
Ana (oncall): quick handover — I'm about to pass primary to Priya. Things to know:
- Open pager: PROD-672 latency spike (still degraded for some customers). Root cause suspected: kv-cache pressure during burst; mitigation in-flight.
- Primary/secondary: Priya = primary (18:00->02:00 PT), Mike = secondary overnight but will be on-call only for paging after 22:00 PT (coverage gap 21:00-22:00 we discussed below).
- Runbooks: follow `runbooks/prod/latency-kv-cache.md`. Quick mitigation we used:
  ```
  # scale down batch_size and flush prefix cache
  curl -XPOST https://console.redwood/internal/ops/cache/flush -d '{"prefix":"user:active"}'
  OR toggle fallback route: /routes/low-latency -> model-small
  ```
- Customer impact: Some interactive sessions to enterprise customers in us-west show 2-3s added tail latency; embeddings unaffected. CS ticket created (TICKET-8893).
- Outstanding: need a short postmortem, confirm whether autoscaler rule applied correctly. I'll create follow-ups after I sign off in 10m. :wave:

Priya S: taking primary — thanks Ana. I'll keep the mitigation running and monitor 1m/5m p50/p95. If latency doesn't improve in 30m I'll escalate to model-restart. Can someone confirm if we have permission to restart model pool for dedicated? @Sam (ops)

Sam (ops): confirm — restart is allowed for dedicated pool but need an ops ticket for tracking. If you call `ops-restart --pool prod-serving` it will create the ticket automatically. I'll stand by to approve if needed.

IncidentBot: [ALERT] PROD-672 still OPEN — current p95 latency 980ms (baseline 180ms). Pager triggered 3 times in last hour. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/PROD-672

Mike R: noted on coverage gap 21:00-22:00 — I can extend to 21:30 if needed but have a customer sync at 21:15 PT. @Priya S does 21:30->22:00 need extra attention?

Priya S: thanks Mike. Prob okay for 21:30->22:00 to be secondary-only as long as we keep the fallback route active. If IncidentBot pages again I'll call you. Also filing a tracking ticket for autoscale rule evaluation.

Mike R: ok. If this gets paged during my meeting I'll ping briefly, otherwise I'll catch up after 22:00.

Jordan L: small note — during the last spike we saw a surge of identical prefixes from a single integration (crm-sync). Suggest follow-up action: rate-limit per-integration at the edge for identical-prefix writes. Can someone add to postmortem actions?

Ana (oncall): adding Jordan's item to action list. I'll create the follow-up list and calendar invite for a 30-min retro tomorrow 10:00 PT. Action items I'm adding now:
- TICKET-8893 (CS): customer impact, notify accounts
- TICKET-8894 (ENG): autoscaler rule audit
- TICKET-8895 (ENG): add per-integration rate-limit for prefix writes
- RETRO-1795: schedule 30m postmortem (Ana -> owner, Priya -> facilitator)
I'll also attach logs and the KV cache stats snapshot to each ticket.

Sam (ops): created ops-tracking ticket TICKET-8896 for any pool restarts. If you want me to approve a restart later just drop the command.

IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigations applied: prefix flush and fallback route active. Status: partial recovery, monitoring.

Priya S: p95 dropped to 320ms after fallback route, still above baseline but much improved. I'll keep watch for 40m and then handoff summary to Mike at 22:00. Will also post final notes to #incidents.

Ana (oncall): thanks team — passing primary to Priya now. Leaving raw notes in the ticket. Priya, if anything urgent after my sign-off you can @me directly. :thumbsup:
